messages:
alice: Heads up — planning a coordinated deploy TOMORROW 02:00 UTC. runtime v3.4.1, api v2.12.0, router v1.9, console flag rollout (feat.new-routing). Any blockers?
ben: ACK. runtime team will run canary in waves. Need router schema pin and clear fallback plan.
dave: Console change is just a flag toggle + small UI label. Will push config at T-30m and hold.
carol: API change adds header validation for X-RD-Auth; we'll ship a compatibility layer. Plan to keep api v2.11.4 pinned as fallback for 1h post-cutover.
deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled 1995080000-1995083600 (02:00-03:00 UTC). Preflight checks queued.
emma: SRE will own the cutover & monitor. Oncall = @emma. If p99 latency > 300ms for >5m or error rate > 1% we abort and start rollback.
ben: Canary plan proposal: 1% -> 10% (after 10m) -> 50% (after 15m) -> 100% (after 30m). We keep autoscaling/pod limits same.
alice: Decision: pin router config to router:v1.9-pin-2026-03-20 during canary so console toggles are deterministic. Console team will gate the flag.
carol: Added release notes & quick rollback steps: https://internal/release-notes/2026-03-20-cross-service-deploy (internal). Please review the rollback commands section.
dave: Quick rollback snippet for console toggle:
```
# revert feature flag
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/flags/feat.new-routing -d '{"enabled":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
ben: Runtime rollback snippet (if canary shows model or mem issues):
```
# rollback runtime deployment to previous revision\kubectl rollout undo deploy/runtime -n prod --to-revision=3
```
deploy-bot: Preflight checks PASSED: infra health ok, capacity OK, config diff clean, secrets rotation OK.
emma: Oncall dashboard (watch list): token latency, router errors, api-4xx/5xx. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/rr/token-latency. I'll open an incident channel if thresholds hit.
alice: Final owners: canary = ben, rollback = carol, console gating = dave, oncall = emma. Start at 02:00 UTC. I'll post final go/no-go at 01:45 UTC. :thumbsup:
